shared_elements: incised linear band running across/around a flat slab surface
angular straight-stroke marks resembling script characters
no figural imagery; purely linear/geometric marks
framing line following the slab edge
justification: Both surfaces are aniconic slabs bearing only incised linear bands filled with angular, straight-stroke sign-like characters, with a line following the edge of the stone, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme rather than generic ornament. The clearest difference in depicted content is that A's bands run straight along the slab's margins in an ordered frame with several separate registers, whereas B shows a single sweeping curved arc of marks crossing the field, and B's carving is far sparser with no comparable multi-register layout visible.
